structure: A Playwright trace corpus of the Design Release 2.1 prototype (GB-notification-service, served under /design-release-2.1), recorded on 27 November 2026 with Playwright 1.61.1 by the fit-style suite in workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/prototype-specs/e2e (the prototype:dr2-1-specs source). 156 trace zips sit flat in workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/traces-prototype/, with index.json mapping each zip to its spec, test title, status and the pages it walked. All 156 passed. They come from 12 spec files: about-the-consignment (22: notification type, origin of the import, what are you importing, main import reason, germinal section 1), address-book (9: the INS address book list, add, view, edit, delete), consignment-parties (14: the roles and addresses page and its pickers, CPH number, add-address hand-offs, permanent address, contact address), dashboard (9: prototype index, overall dashboard, live animals and germinal products category dashboards, at a glance drill-downs), description-of-the-goods (13: commodity details, total gross weight, identification details per species, additional details), documents (7: upload documents), eudpa-691 (4: Back and return-to-hub behaviour of the run), journeys (9: 5 whole journeys end to end, about 250 actions each, and 4 notification hub tests), manage-notifications (7: view, amend, cancel amend, copy as new, delete), snagging (37: snags S01 to S38, without S30, each a focused look at one page's look and feel), templates (12: manage, create, view, edit, change, use, delete) and transport-and-arrival (13: arrival details, transit countries, transporter details, add a transporter). Most traces walk the opening run (create-notification, notification-type, origin, what are you importing, reason) to reach their page, so those pages recur in nearly every trace. A sample opened with tim's Playwright 1.65.0 showed 40 to 260 actions a trace, about 5 per page walked, and 0 errors; failed-validation states are shown as rendered pages, not trace errors. The corpus is indexed from index.json in trace-prototype-dr2-1.work/index-dr2-1.tsv. The scope is every trace in the folder; it leaves out nothing in it, but it shows only what the suite walked, so pages and branches the suite did not reach (and the prototype's intro, /design-release-2 and /testing areas) are not here. The parts are cut by journey step group across spec files: each snagging section goes with the part that owns its page, the end-to-end journeys are two parts of their own, and dashboards, manage notifications, templates and the address book are a part each.
